Hariiro — third-party components bundled in components\

The Hariiro release ZIP includes two foobar2000 components so that the installer can set up a
fresh foobar2000 in one step. They are unmodified binaries (64-bit) of the versions below, each
under its own MIT License (components\<name>\LICENSE.txt). The installer copies a component
only when foobar2000 does not have it yet; an installed copy is never replaced.

Panels UI (reborn) — foo_ui_panels 1.27.1
  Copyright (c) 2026 Santiago Rodriguez — MIT License
  https://github.com/santiagorod92/foo_ui_panels

JS Panel — foo_js_panel 1.9.2
  Copyright (c) 2026 Santiago Rodriguez — MIT License
  https://github.com/santiagorod92/foo_js_panel

Not included: foobar2000 itself (its licence allows redistributing only the unmodified
installer: get it from https://www.foobar2000.org/) and ESLyric (optional).
